failureRules: commit failure identifies completed prefix and uncertain fragment
MemoryAccessException is a CStructReadException: ReadLimitExceeded for BudgetExceeded, otherwise ReadFailed
source coordinates are null when a failure has no source address
path errors are CStructPathException, value errors CStructWriteException, definition and metadata errors CStructLayoutException
parameter-contract violations, read-only sources, and cancellation keep .NET exception types

metadata.btf: v1 reachable or field-directed value types and split tables; no ELF extraction
metadata.isf: 6.2.0 reachable or field-directed type subsets; shallow user-type descriptions; document-owned bounded successful scalar compilation; no profile matching or relocations

projection.paths: explicit member/index/pointer paths; terminal composites and arrays include by-value closure; pointer targets require an explicit value path or another selected by-value use
projection.placement: original IDs, root sizes, array stride, field offsets, byte order and bit slices are preserved
projection.availability: IsProjected and UnselectedMembers describe omitted composite members; IsUnselected distinguishes deliberately address-only target identities from missing metadata; schemas never expand implicitly
projection.validation: selected descriptors and placements, direct names and promoted ambiguity candidates; omitted ordinary descriptors are not validated; full Import keeps full reachable validation
projection.limits: MaxTypes bounds distinct planning and emitted descriptors; MaxProjectionWork bounds path-text/path-step/native-member/promotion/closure work; promotion search memoizes shared DAGs and stops after two matches
projection.writes: whole-value encoding rejects composites with omitted members; selected-field updates preserve unrelated bytes

prepared.lifetime: immutable schema decisions only; no retained source bytes, pointer values or operation contexts
prepared.fixedOffset: root-relative byte offset only without a pointer value step
prepared.typed: 8/16/24/32/64-bit integers, bool, float32/float64, enum results, bit slices and StoredPointer; other scalar codecs bind as object
prepared.failure: Try operations distinguish schema, path, type, pointer, extent, codec and storage failures; cancellation and budgets terminate

exactReads: destination must fit the finite region before transport; positive short reads continue; zero length checks cancellation without requests; copied prefix remains and unread bytes stay untouched

arrays.count: destination elements times schema stride must fit an explicit permitted region; flexible counts never extend a root header
arrays.transport: elementwise by default; bounded bulk is explicit and changes request accounting
arrays.completion: every complete element of the confirmed copied prefix is committed on unavailable memory; incomplete and unread elements remain untouched
arrays.customCodecs: ordinary reads retain callback semantics; typed bulk rejects custom and enum codecs

borrowedBuffers: non-owning ReadOnlyMemory at an unsigned base address; explicit readable prefix; caller guarantees lifetime and stability; generation zero; requested bytes charge local decoding work
resolver: Func<PointerRequest, MemoryAccessContext, MemoryRegion>; pointer storage, translation and target reads share the active context; no context retention
traversalIdentity: source object and address by default; an explicit caller callback may canonicalize aliased views while returned nodes retain their original sources

discovery.buffer: fixed scalar fields use exact selected extents and explicit validity; predicates never see unknown bytes
discovery.bytes: prepared one-byte arrays preserve raw bits and bypass custom codecs; text policy is application-owned
discovery.scan: borrowed bounded windows, owned starts, same-source adjacency only, no holes joined, explicit stride and stop reasons
discovery.snapshot: bounded fixed field selections; elementwise default; coalescing opt-in with independent gap recovery; owned validity and generation observations
discovery.provenance: optional dynamic mapping descriptions; source identity and unsigned coordinates; no atomicity; patch flattening remains static
discovery.graph: ordered streaming BFS/DFS; caller canonical identity; bounded nodes, edges, depth and frontier; explicit partial stop reasons
